chain.text: The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients and has 6 consultation rooms. It opens 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday. Twelve nurses work in three shifts, plus four administrative staff. Accreditation has been held since April 2022 and expires in April 2027. Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records. Attendance averages 180 consultations daily, peaking at 310 in January 2025. The no-show rate is 9 percent, down from 14 percent since September 2024. In March 2024 a vaccine fridge failed overnight, discarding 2,100 euros of stock. A networked temperature alarm is now checked every morning with a paper backup log. In November 2024 a concurrent update overwrote a patient's allergy field. The record system now locks a record while it is open.
